required_concepts: Continuous data can take any value within a range
critical_errors: Labeling as discrete without explaining fractional possibilities
Assuming whole-number reporting defines data type
misconceptions: Believing whole-number reporting makes it discrete
Thinking time data must be integer-based
Confusing measurement tools with data type
grading_notes: Emphasize that data type is determined by potential values, not reporting method. Accept explanations linking time measurement to continuous scales.
